title: Sai Vidyud Senthil Nathan
text:
Welcome! I’m a graduate studnet researcher focused on exoplanets and astrophotonic instrumentation. This site collects my research and engineering projects throughout my undergraduate and graduate studies.
I’m currently a graduate student in astronomy and astrophysics at University of California, Los Angeles. My interests span all things related to exoplanets (detection, atmospheres, dynamics) and instrumentation (spectroscopy, photometry, astrophotonics).
Explore my projects and research, or read a bit about me.
